title: Under a cosimplicial resolution and an isomorphism of L pi_! on the structure sheaves, L pi_! K agrees with L pi_! of the extended scalars
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-cohomology.tex (Cohomology on Sites)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file sites-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma computes L pi_! after extension of scalars along a map of sheaves of rings O -> O' on a category with chaotic topology, under the two assumptions of a suitable cosimplicial object and the isomorphism L pi_!O = L pi_!O' (statement lines 10421-10436). The proof (proof lines 10438-10483) reduces to the sheaves j_{U!}O_U, builds the simplicial abelian groups whose associated complexes compute the relevant L pi_!, and uses functoriality in the simplicial set together with the assumed quasi-isomorphism P_bullet -> P'_bullet to deduce that the two complexes are quasi-isomorphic. H2: one reduction and one simplicial comparison, both written out.
